This '''national electoral calendar for 2021''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2021 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*10 January:
**[[Elections in Kazakhstan|Kazakhstan]], [[2021 Kazakh legislative election|Assembly]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Kazakhstan Sets January 10 Date For Parliamentary Elections |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kazakhstan-parliamentary-parliamentary-elections-kazakhstan-2021/30904379.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty|RFE/RL's Kazakh Service]] |date=21 October 2020 |access-date=21 October 2020}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyzstan]], [[2021 Kyrgyz presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Kyrgyzstan Schedules Early Presidential Election For January 10|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyzstan-schedules-early-presidential-election-for-january-10/30910266.html|date=24 October 2020|publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty|RFE/RL's Kyrgyz Service]]|access-date=24 October 2020}}</ref> and [[2021 Kyrgyz referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Kyrgyz Presidential Hopeful Japarov Defends Draft Constitutional Reforms|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyz-presidential-hopeful-japarov-defends-draft-constitutional-reforms/30967116.html|date=24 November 2020|publisher=RFE/RL's Kyrgyz Service|access-date=25 November 2020}}</ref>
*14 January: [[Elections in Uganda|Uganda]], [[2021 Ugandan general election|President and Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ec.or.ug/polling-dates-2021-general-elections|title=Polling Dates for 2021 General Elections|date=9 November 2020|publisher=Uganda Electoral Commission|access-date=31 January 2021}}</ref>
*24 January: [[Elections in Portugal|Portugal]], [[2021 Portuguese presidential election|President]]<ref>{{Cite web|last=SAPO|title=Marcelo marca eleições presidenciais para 24 de janeiro|url=https://24.sapo.pt/atualidade/artigos/presidente-da-republica-marca-eleicoes-presidenciais-para-24-de-janeiro|access-date=2021-08-10|website=SAPO 24|language=pt}}</ref>

==February==
*7 February:
**[[Elections in Ecuador|Ecuador]], [[2021 Ecuadorian general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]<ref name="Ecuador">{{cite news |title=Ecuador election: Frontrunner Andrés Arauz takes lead in presidential vote |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-55934856 |date=7 February 2021 |work=BBC News |access-date=7 February 2021}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2021 Liechtenstein general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.radio.li/news-1/termin-fuer-landtagswahl-2021-festgelegt|title=Date set for state elections in 2021|work=Radio Liechtenstein|date=12 November 2019|access-date=9 August 2020|archive-date=12 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201112192507/https://www.radio.li/news-1/termin-fuer-landtagswahl-2021-festgelegt|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*14 February: ''[[Elections in Kosovo|Kosovo]], [[2021 Kosovan parliamentary election|Parliament]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Kosovo's Acting President Calls Early Parliamentary Elections For February 14 |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kosovo-s-acting-president-calls-early-parliamentary-elections-for-february-14/31037169.html |date=7 January 2021 |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |access-date=8 January 2021}}</ref>
*19 February: ''[[Elections in the Turks and Caicos Islands|Turks and Caicos Islands]], [[2021 Turks and Caicos Islands general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jamaicaobserver.com/latestnews/Turks_&_Caicos_premier_calls_general_election_for_February_19|title=Turks & Caicos premier calls general election for February 19|work=[[Jamaica Observer]]|date=10 January 2021|access-date=12 January 2021}}</ref>
*21 February:
**[[Elections in Laos|Laos]], [[2021 Laotian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Laos elects members for 9th National Assembly|url=http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-02/21/c_139756841.htm|access-date=2021-08-10|website=www.xinhuanet.com|archive-date=2021-02-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210222084035/http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-02/21/c_139756841.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Niger|Niger]], [[2020–21 Nigerien general election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Niger presidential election heads to February runoff |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/2/niger-presidential-election-heads-to-runoff |publisher=[[Al Jazeera English|Al Jazeera]] |date=2 January 2020 |access-date=2 January 2020}}</ref>
*28 February: [[Elections in El Salvador|El Salvador]], [[2021 Salvadoran legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Big Victory Comes With Big Expectations for El Salvador's Young New President|url=https://www.worldpoliticsreview.com/articles/27407/big-victory-comes-with-big-expectations-for-el-salvador-s-young-new-president|access-date=2021-08-10|website=www.worldpoliticsreview.com|date=11 February 2019 |language=en}}</ref>

==March==
*2 March: [[Politics of the Federated States of Micronesia|Federated States of Micronesia]], [[2021 Micronesian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fsmned.fm/news.htm|title=National Election News|publisher=FSM National Election Office|access-date=9 August 2020}}</ref>
*6 March: [[Elections in Ivory Coast|Ivory Coast]], [[2021 Ivorian parliamentary election|National Assembly]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.afrique-sur7.fr/445096-legislatives-2021-cei-6-mars|title=Ivory Coast: Here is the probable date of the 2021 legislative elections|work=Afrique Sur 7|language=fr|date=22 December 2020|access-date=2 January 2021}}</ref>
*7 March: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2021 Swiss referendums#March referendums|Referendums]]<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-02-17|title=EXPLAINED: What is at stake in Switzerland's March 7th referendums?|url=https://www.thelocal.ch/20210217/explained-what-is-at-stake-in-switzerlands-march-7th-referendums/|access-date=2021-12-12|website=The Local Switzerland|language=en-US}}</ref>
*14 March: [[Elections in the Central African Republic|Central African Republic]], [[2020–21 Central African general election|Parliament (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/13/car-to-hold-runoff-parliamentary-elections-in-march|title=CAR to hold runoff parliamentary elections in March|work=[[Al Jazeera English|Al Jazeera]]|date=13 February 2021|access-date=15 February 2021}}</ref>
*15–17 March: [[Elections in the Netherlands|Netherlands]], [[2021 Dutch general election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite news|last=Holligan |first=Anna |title=Dutch head to polls as Covid crisis looms large |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-56355215 |date=16 March 2021 |publisher=BBC News |access-date=19 March 2021}}</ref>
*17 March: ''[[Politics of Saint Helena|Saint Helena]], [[2021 Saint Helena governance system referendum|Referendum]]''<ref>{{Cite web|title=Consultative Poll on Governance Reform - the Results|url=https://www.sainthelena.gov.sh/2021/news/consultative-poll-on-governance-reform-the-results/|date=18 March 2021|work=www.sainthelena.gov.sh|access-date=11 August 2021}}</ref>
*19 March: ''[[Elections in Curaçao|Curaçao]], [[2021 Curaçao general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://knipselkrant-curacao.com/paradisefm-19-maart-2021-verkiezingen/|title=March 19, 2021 elections|work=Paradise FM|date=6 May 2020|access-date=10 August 2020|archive-date=5 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200605154620/https://www.knipselkrant-curacao.com/paradisefm-19-maart-2021-verkiezingen/|url-status=dead}} {{in lang|nl}}</ref>
*21 March: [[Elections in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of Congo]], [[2021 Republic of the Congo presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web |last=Vodjo |first=Casimir |title=Congo: Denis Sassou Nguesso fixe la date de la présidentielle |url=https://beninwebtv.com/2020/12/congo-denis-sassou-nguesso-fixe-la-date-de-la-presidentielle/ |date=23 December 2020 |work=Benin Web TV |access-date=23 December 2020 |lang=FR-fr |archive-date=21 March 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210321160351/https://beninwebtv.com/2020/12/congo-denis-sassou-nguesso-fixe-la-date-de-la-presidentielle/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*23 March: [[Elections in Israel|Israel]], [[2021 Israeli legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/gideon-saar-blasts-netanyahu-gantz-budget-deal-652786/|title=Election prevention bill fails, Israel headed to elections on March 23|date=22 December 2020|work=[[The Jerusalem Post]]|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>

==April==
*4 April: [[Elections in Bulgaria|Bulgaria]], [[April 2021 Bulgarian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Bulgarian President Calls General Election For April 4 |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/bulgaria-president-radev-general-election-april-4/31046922.html |date=14 January 2021 |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty|RFE/RL's Bulgarian Service]] |access-date=14 January 2021}}</ref>
*6 April: ''[[Elections in Greenland|Greenland]], [[2021 Greenlandic general election|Parliament]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Greenland's parliament calls an early election |url=https://www.arctictoday.com/greenland-will-hold-an-early-election/ |date=17 February 2021 |publisher=Arctic Today |access-date=15 March 2021}}</ref>
*9 April:
**[[Elections in Djibouti|Djibouti]], [[2021 Djiboutian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://french.xinhuanet.com/afrique/2020-12/09/c_139575377.htm|title=Djibouti: the date of the presidential elections set for April 9, 2021|work=[[Xinhua News Agency]]|language=fr|date=9 December 2020|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Samoa|Samoa]], [[2021 Samoan general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite news|last=Frost|first=Natasha|date=2021-07-26|title=Ending Bitter 3-Month Standoff, Samoa's Leader Concedes Election Defeat|language=en-US|work=The New York Times|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2021/07/26/world/australia/samoa-election-concede.html|access-date=2021-12-12|issn=0362-4331}}</ref>
*11 April:
**[[Elections in Benin|Benin]], [[2021 Beninese presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.koaci.com/index.php/article/2020/11/26/benin/Politique/benin-la-presidentielle-fixee-au-11-avril-2021-patrice-talon-promet-de-faire-participer-lopposition_146955.html|title=Benin: The Presidential set for April 11, 2021, Patrice Talon promises to involve the opposition|website=KOACI|language=fr|date=26 November 2020|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Chad|Chad]], [[2021 Chadian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{Cite news|date=2021-04-11|title=Chad presidential election: Idriss Déby seeks sixth term amid boycott|language=en-GB|work=BBC News|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-56708261|access-date=2021-12-12}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Ecuador|Ecuador]], [[2021 Ecuadorian general election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="Ecuador"/>
**[[Elections in Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyzstan]], [[2021 Kyrgyz constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Kyrgyz Parliament Approves Law For Referendum On Constitutional Changes, Sets April 11 Date |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/krygzstan-constitutional-changes-law-passed-referendum-apil-11/31145246.html |date=11 March 2021 |publisher=RFE/RL's Kyrgyz Service |access-date=11 March 2021}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Peru|Peru]], [[2021 Peruvian general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]<ref name="Peru">{{cite news |title=Peru: Leftist Pedro Castillo leads presidential race, exit poll says |url=https://www.dw.com/en/peru-leftist-pedro-castillo-leads-presidential-race-exit-poll-says/a-57162499 |date=11 April 2021 |publisher=[[Deutsche Welle]] |access-date=11 April 2021}}</ref>
*14 April: ''[[Elections in the Cayman Islands|Cayman Islands]], [[2021 Caymanian general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.loopcayman.com/content/cayman-elections-moved-april-14|title=Cayman elections moved to April 14|work=Loop News|date=10 February 2021|access-date=11 February 2021|archive-date=10 February 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210210221025/http://www.loopcayman.com/content/cayman-elections-moved-april-14|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*18 April: [[Elections in Cape Verde|Cape Verde]], [[2021 Cape Verdean parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref name="LusaNewsAgency">{{cite web|author=[[Lusa News Agency]]|url=https://www.dw.com/pt-002/j%C3%A1-h%C3%A1-datas-para-legislativas-e-presidenciais-em-cabo-verde/a-56205634|title=There are already legislative and presidential dates in Cape Verde|work=[[Deutsche Welle]]|language=pt|date=12 January 2021|access-date=17 January 2021}}</ref>
*25 April: [[Elections in Albania|Albania]], [[2021 Albanian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://balkaninsight.com/2020/07/24/albania-promises-to-emigrants-to-vote-in-the-national-elections/|title=Tirana Promises Albanians Abroad Voting Rights in Elections|work=[[Balkan Insight]]|date=24 July 2020|access-date=9 August 2020}}</ref>

==May==
*15–16 May: [[Elections in Chile|Chile]], [[2021 Chilean Constitutional Convention election|Constituent Assembly]]<ref>{{cite news|date=26 October 2020|title=Jubilation as Chile votes to rewrite constitution|work=BBC News|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54687090|access-date=26 October 2020}}</ref>
*23 May: [[Elections in Vietnam|Vietnam]], [[2021 Vietnamese legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://en.nhandan.org.vn/politics/domestic/item/8579402-vietnam-plans-to-hold-general-elections-in-may-2021.html|title=Vietnam plans to hold general elections in May 2021|work=[[Nhân Dân]]|date=16 April 2020|access-date=9 August 2020}}</ref>
*26 May: [[Elections in Syria|Syria]], [[2021 Syrian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syria-hold-presidential-elections-may-26-parliament-2021-04-18/|title=Syria to hold presidential elections on May 26 - parliament|date=18 April 2021|work=Reuters|access-date=3 May 2021}}</ref>
*30 May: [[Elections in Cyprus|Cyprus]], [[2021 Cypriot legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pio.gov.cy/ανακοινωθέντα-άρθρο.html?id=17723|title=Parliamentary elections 2021 - Polling stations abroad|publisher=Republic of Cyprus Ministry of the Interior, Press and Information Office|language=el|date=4 January 2021|access-date=18 January 2021}}</ref>
*31 May: ''[[Elections in Somaliland|Somaliland]], [[2021 Somaliland parliamentary election|House of Representatives]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.somalilandpresidency.com/somaliland-national-electoral-commission-to-slate-election-schedule/|title=Somaliland National Electoral Commission to Slate Election Schedule|publisher=The President's Office, Republic of Somaliland|date=16 January 2021|access-date=18 January 2021|archive-date=17 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210117164438/https://www.somalilandpresidency.com/somaliland-national-electoral-commission-to-slate-election-schedule/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==June==
*6 June:
**[[Elections in Mexico|Mexico]], [[2021 Mexican legislative election|Chamber of Deputies]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mexico votes in widely anticipated midterm elections|url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/6/polls-open-in-mexicos-widely-anticipated-midterm-elections|access-date=2021-12-12|website=www.aljazeera.com|language=en}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Peru|Peru]], [[2021 Peruvian general election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="Peru"/>
*9 June: [[Elections in Mongolia|Mongolia]], [[2021 Mongolian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://montsame.mn/en/read/250819|title=Presidential election scheduled for June 9, 2021|work=[[Montsame]]|date=21 January 2021|access-date=23 January 2021}}</ref>
*12 June: [[Elections in Algeria|Algeria]], [[2021 Algerian legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Low turnout as Algerians vote in parliamentary election|url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/12/algerians-vote-in-parliamentary-election|access-date=2021-12-12|website=www.aljazeera.com|language=en}}</ref>
*13 June: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2021 Swiss referendums|Referendums]]<ref name="swiss">{{cite web|url=https://www.bk.admin.ch/ch/f/pore/va/vab_1_3_3_1.html|title=Voting dates for the next 20 years|publisher=Federal Chancellery of Switzerland|access-date=10 August 2020|archive-date=12 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200812183940/https://www.bk.admin.ch/ch/f/pore/va/vab_1_3_3_1.html|url-status=dead}} {{in lang|fr}}</ref>
*18 June: [[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2021 Iranian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{Cite news|date=2021-06-18|title=Iranians vote in presidential election marred by disqualification row|language=en-GB|work=BBC News|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-57510763|access-date=2021-12-12}}</ref>
*20 June: [[Elections in Armenia|Armenia]], [[2021 Armenian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Embattled Armenian PM Announces Early Parliamentary Elections In June|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/armenia-pashinian-early-parliamentary-elections-called/31157523.html|date=18 March 2021|publisher=RFE/RL's Armenian Service|access-date=18 March 2021}}</ref>
*21–22 June: [[Elections in Ethiopia|Ethiopia]], [[2021 Ethiopian general election|House of Representatives (1st stage)]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Ethiopia postpones elections again to 21 June|url=https://www.africanews.com/2021/05/20/ethiopia-postpones-elections-again-to-21-june/|date=20 May 2021|publisher=[[Africanews]]|access-date=20 May 2021}}</ref>
*24 June: ''[[Elections in Gibraltar|Gibraltar]], [[2021 Gibraltar abortion referendum|Referendum]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gbc.gi/news/government-expects-abortion-referendum-place-or-june-year|title=Government expects abortion referendum to take place by June this year|work=GBC|date=18 February 2021|access-date=2 March 2021}}</ref>
*25 June: ''[[Elections in Aruba|Aruba]], [[2021 Aruban general election|Parliament]]''<ref>{{cite news|title=Aruba Election 2021|url=https://www.arubatoday.com/aruba-election-2021-2/|publisher=Aruba Today|access-date=27 May 2021}}</ref>

==July==
*11 July:
**[[Elections in Bulgaria|Bulgaria]], [[July 2021 Bulgarian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Bulgaria Set For Early Elections After Last Attempt To Form Government Fails |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/bulgaria-set-for-early-elections-/31233530.html |date=1 May 2021 |publisher=RFE/RL's Bulgarian Service |access-date=2 May 2021}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Moldova|Moldova]], [[2021 Moldovan parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Moldovan leader dissolves parliament, sets July elections |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210428-moldovan-leader-dissolves-parliament-sets-july-elections |date=28 April 2021 |work=France24 |access-date=28 April 2021}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2021 Slovenian Waters Act referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Referendum on changes to water act to be held on 11 July|url=https://sloveniatimes.com/referendum-on-changes-to-water-act-to-be-held-on-11-july/|date=25 May 2021|website=Slovenia Times|access-date=1 June 2021|archive-date=31 May 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210531034009/https://sloveniatimes.com/referendum-on-changes-to-water-act-to-be-held-on-11-july/|url-status=dead}}.</ref>
*18 July: [[Elections in São Tomé and Príncipe|São Tomé and Príncipe]], [[2021 São Toméan presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mais de uma dezena de candidatos às eleições presidenciais sãotomenses|url=https://www.rfi.fr/pt/s%C3%A3o-tom%C3%A9-e-pr%C3%ADncipe/20210612-mais-de-uma-dezena-de-candidatos-%C3%A0s-elei%C3%A7%C3%B5es-presidenciais-s%C3%A3otomenses|date=12 June 2021|access-date=2 July 2021|website=RFI|language=pt}}</ref>
*26 July: [[Elections in Saint Lucia|Saint Lucia]], [[2021 Saint Lucian general election|House of Assembly]]<ref>{{cite web |last1=Gaillard |first1=Sharefil |title=PM 'can't focus on elections' due to concerns of COVID outbreak |url=https://stlucia.loopnews.com/content/pm-i-cant-focus-elections |website=Loop News |access-date=7 June 2021 |date=30 April 2021 |archive-date=7 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210607145048/https://stlucia.loopnews.com/content/pm-i-cant-focus-elections |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==August==
*1 August: [[Elections in Mexico|Mexico]], [[2021 Mexican corruption trial referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{Cite news|last1=Oré|first1=Diego|last2=Diaz|first2=Lizbeth|date=2021-08-02|title=Mexico holds referendum on whether to probe ex-presidents|language=en|work=Reuters|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-holds-referendum-whether-probe-ex-presidents-2021-08-01/|access-date=2021-12-12}}</ref>
*12 August: [[Elections in Zambia|Zambia]], [[2021 Zambian general election|President and Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-11/09/c_139503847.htm|title=Zambia commences voter registration exercise ahead of 2021 polls|work=[[Xinhua News Agency]]|date=9 November 2020|access-date=13 December 2020}}</ref>

==September==
*5 September: [[Elections in São Tomé and Príncipe|São Tomé and Príncipe]], [[2021 São Toméan presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sao-tome-presidential-run-off-pit-ex-pm-against-former-minister-2021-07-19/|title=Sao Tome presidential run-off to pit ex-PM against former minister|publisher=Reuters|date=19 July 2021}}</ref>
*8 September: [[Elections in Morocco|Morocco]], [[2021 Moroccan general election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{Cite web|last=AfricaNews|date=2021-09-08|title=Polls open in Morocco's regional and parliamentary elections|url=https://www.africanews.com/2021/09/08/polls-open-in-morocco-s-regional-and-parliamentary-elections/|url-status=live|access-date=2021-12-12|website=Africanews|language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210908110919/https://www.africanews.com/2021/09/08/polls-open-in-morocco-s-regional-and-parliamentary-elections/ |archive-date=2021-09-08 }}</ref>
